scope_review: Independent source is cached paper text, with header 2025-05-27; exact ePrint PDF revision and byte hash remain unavailable. Lemma9.1 concerns ordinary KZG function binding, not state-restoration function binding of batched/linearized KZG or the full Plonk theorem. Cached Definition9.5 differs from the Lean citation number9.6. Paper degree <=D and Lean degree<n suggest n=D+1, but ARSDH cardinality/degree conventions require explicit review; do not silently identify n with D. Paper circuit-size bounds, auxiliary distribution, private tau and group-generator hypotheses must remain visible. Lean hp:p>=n+2 and pairing nondegeneracy are explicit formal qualifications; no claim that paper discharges every Lean qualification. After version bounds a specific adversary subject to reduction membership in Adv; this exposes an adversary-class boundary but does not itself instantiate paper circuit-size bounds or prove the stated reduction runtime.
